instance.environmentSelection: Use owner region/staging contract; profile origin is current reviewed US entry

auth.nativeCredentialPath: TMT_TOKEN in approved environment or private verified token file; GET-only scoped project for reads, role-inheriting PAT for authorized writes
auth.missingCredentialWorkflow: Use web-access on original browser to complete Feishu OAuth Session, then declared project/personal issuer if authorized; no JWT/device grant guessed

identity.token: GET /api/role/current data.userId; ApiTokenAuthFilter does not populate userId on getCurrentUser

auth.resources: Actual project operation input and detail response bound by createTrackingAdapter; backend appId attribute alone is not universally enforced
auth.retention: once revoke+readback before browser cleanup; save private record with expiry, stop listeners/tunnels regardless
auth.issuer: auth-profile.json tokenIssuers; interactive-cookie only, never token-to-token mint

nativeRoute.reads: Existing REST/Project Token and CLI; source catalog76 routes
nativeRoute.writes: PAT REST with owner permissions; event/workorder/publish use contract and CI gates; missing backend routes stay unsupported

versionPolicy: Match backend/frontend commits to deployed versions before promoting runtime coverage; source or DOM change refreshes affected contract

verification.runtime: historical 7 reads on app2370 only; current token issuance/full roles/write/publish unverified
